text: What is a chorus? A band composed of human beings, who dance and sing; but suppose the company proceed to act as each may chance, confusion follows; the spectacle has lost its charm. How different when each and all together act and recite with orderly precision, the limbs and voices keeping time and tune. Then, indeed, these same performers are worth seeing and worth hearing.
author: Xenophon
speaker: Ischomachus
